items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Taro stems' to USDA SR Legacy 'Taro shoots, raw'. The destination identifies the edible taro stalk/stem portion, and the target's own immutable candidate evidence contains the USDA taro-shoot record at rank 4 with the same species, Colocasia esculenta. Confidence remains medium because culinary sources may use 'stems', 'stalks', 'petioles', and 'shoots' somewhat differently and preparation can affect water content; this decision does not generalize to taro root/corm, taro leaves, cooked taro shoots, or other colocasia preparations.
